summary: Gerdau S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its condensed consolidated interim financial statements as of June 30, 2026. The filing presents routine quarterly results, including balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow data, with no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event. The registrant is a Brazilian steel producer reporting as a foreign private issuer. This is a standard periodic earnings disclosure with no corporate action or strategic transaction announced. Consequently, the filing does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
